strategy.title: Price strategy
strategy.description: Price suggestions take the competitors' middle price for the night times the price position you choose, add demand signals (tight nights, rooms booked, holidays), then keep within your floor/ceiling and maximum daily change.
strategy.defaults: No strategy of your own yet: the system keeps your usual price position (≈{index}% of the competitors' middle price, measured over the next 30 days). Save to set a different position.
strategy.driftNote: Your price position is also used for the “Your rate drifted from your price position” alert in <link>Alerts</link>.
strategy.noOwnBody: Add your hotel (role “Your hotel”) to the watchlist to set a price strategy.

field.baseHint: Used when fewer than 3 competitors have a rate to compare.
field.targetIndexHint: 100% = level with the competitors' middle price; 105% = 5% above; 95% = 5% below.
field.weekdayHint: % added or removed for each night of the week, −30% to +50%. Empty = 0.
field.holidayHint: % for public holidays, Lunar New Year and source-market holidays, −30% to +50%.
field.lastMinuteAdjHint: −30% to 0%, only when the market isn't tight and you still have plenty of rooms.

invalid.floorCeiling: The floor price must be at or below the ceiling price.
invalid.baseRange: The base price must sit between the floor and ceiling prices.
invalid.targetIndex: The price position must be between 50% and 200%.
invalid.maxChange: The maximum daily change must be a whole number from 1 to 50.
invalid.weekday: Day-of-week adjustments must be whole numbers from −30 to 50.
invalid.holiday: The holiday uplift must be a whole number from −30 to 50.
invalid.lastMinuteDays: The last-minute window must be a whole number from 0 to 14.
invalid.lastMinuteAdj: The last-minute adjustment must be a whole number from −30 to 0.

strategy.defaultsNoTypical: No strategy of your own yet and not enough data to measure your usual price position: the system uses level with the competitors' middle price for now. Save to set a different position.
strategy.positionHint: Compared with the competitors' middle price (half of them cheaper, half pricier).
strategy.limitsHint: Optional. Suggestions never go beyond these.
strategy.advancedShow: Advanced: base price, rounding, weekdays, holidays, last minute

cards.keep: Keep as now (≈{index}% of middle price)
cards.keepHint: Follows your usual price level, recalculated daily; only suggests a change when the market shows a signal (competitors selling out, tight nights, high occupancy…).
cards.cheaperHint: Reference price = middle price × 0.9. Prioritises filling rooms.
cards.levelHint: Reference price = the competitors' middle price.
cards.higherHint: Reference price = middle price × 1.1. When you beat competitors on stars or score.
cards.custom: Using a custom position: {index}% of middle price (set under Advanced).

preview.title: Preview of the next {nights} nights
preview.description: Suggestions for your current choice, not saved yet.
preview.invalid: Fix the field showing an error to see the preview.
preview.note: Listed prices on Booking.com. Once saved, suggestions on Today use these same numbers.
